name: manual_f23387
claim: The git merge/push/PR discipline (never trust marker-grep alone, check MERGE_HEAD before push, verify diff before writing a PR body) is now mechanically enforced, not just a personal habit: orama-system's canonical .githooks/pre-push runs scripts/git/check_no_pending_merge.sh (checks MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD), synced to downstream repos via sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh. The remaining two steps -- context-check (which tree/worktree/branch you're actually in) and verify-diff-before-PR -- are not git-hookable (context is agent state, not a git operation; PR-opening is a gh action, not native git) and stay a standing personal discipline.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-30 follow-up to the periscope PR#39 incident (empty-merge PR opened without ever running git commit). User asked to enshrine the fix as an actual pre-push guard, not just a lesson to remember by hand -- implemented in orama-system (canonical), documented in docs/wiki/08-git-hygiene-and-branching.md § 'Merge -> Push -> PR discipline', and synced out. Closes the loop opened by the two earlier lessons on diff-filter=U and MERGE_HEAD checking.
